name: fis
description: Amazon Web Services Fault Injection Service is a managed service that enables you to perform fault injection experiments on your Amazon Web Services workloads.

subcommands.name: create-experiment-template
subcommands.description: Creates an experiment template.

subcommands.name: create-target-account-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a target account configuration for the experiment template.

subcommands.name: delete-experiment-template
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified experiment template.

subcommands.name: delete-target-account-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified target account configuration of the experiment template.

subcommands.name: get-action
subcommands.description: Gets information about the specified FIS action.

subcommands.name: get-experiment
subcommands.description: Gets information about the specified experiment.

subcommands.name: get-experiment-target-account-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets information about the specified target account configuration of the experiment.

subcommands.name: get-experiment-template
subcommands.description: Gets information about the specified experiment template.

subcommands.name: get-safety-lever
subcommands.description: Gets information about the specified safety lever.

subcommands.name: get-target-account-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets information about the specified target account configuration of the experiment template.

subcommands.name: get-target-resource-type
subcommands.description: Gets information about the specified resource type.

subcommands.name: list-actions
subcommands.description: Lists the available FIS actions.

subcommands.name: list-experiment-resolved-targets
subcommands.description: Lists the resolved targets information of the specified experiment.

subcommands.name: list-experiment-target-account-configurations
subcommands.description: Lists the target account configurations of the specified experiment.

subcommands.name: list-experiment-templates
subcommands.description: Lists your experiment templates.

subcommands.name: list-experiments
subcommands.description: Lists your experiments.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags for the specified resource.

subcommands.name: list-target-account-configurations
subcommands.description: Lists the target account configurations of the specified experiment template.

subcommands.name: list-target-resource-types
subcommands.description: Lists the target resource types.

subcommands.name: start-experiment
subcommands.description: Starts running an experiment from the specified experiment template.

subcommands.name: stop-experiment
subcommands.description: Stops the specified experiment.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Applies the specified tags to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-experiment-template
subcommands.description: Updates the specified experiment template.

subcommands.name: update-safety-lever-state
subcommands.description: Updates the specified safety lever state.

subcommands.name: update-target-account-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the target account configuration for the specified experiment template.
